elements.title: Forgotten Letters
elements.description: A self-hosted campaign companion for Trench Crusade, one copy per gaming group.

elements.title: app
elements.description: Serves pages, form actions, the JSON API and health checks. On start: migrations (after a dump), "setup is open" in the log while there is no owner, listening on the stored port, background jobs.

elements.title: Web (routes)
elements.description: Pages, form actions and API endpoints. They parse input with zod and call one service; no SQL here.

elements.title: App shell, role areas and account
elements.description: The shell: a top bar (Docs, user menu with User settings and Log out) and a sliding left panel with the areas the person can use and the help and legal links. Each role lands in its own area; the Owner changes text size, accent and port under /owner/settings. Every role has Warbands (list, new-warband wizard, builder); fighter images are served from /uploads/fighters/[id] to whoever may see the warband.

elements.title: /account
elements.description:
actions: everywhere, name, password
action:everywhere: Sign out of every other device.
  Who: any signed-in person.
  In: nothing.
  Out: { op: 'everywhere', done: true }.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated.
action:name: Change my display name.
  Who: any signed-in person.
  In: form { displayName }.
  Out: { op: 'name', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated.
action:password: Change my password; my other devices are signed out.
  Who: any signed-in person.
  In: form { current, password }.
  Out: { op: 'password', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid (wrong current password, too common, unchanged), 401 unauthenticated.

elements.title: /account/password
elements.description:
actions: default
action:default: Replace a temporary password after a reset; required before anything else.
  Who: a signed-in person whose password was reset.
  In: form { current (the temporary password), password }.
  Out: 303 to the person's own area; their other devices are signed out.
  Errors: 400 invalid (wrong temporary password, too common, unchanged), 401 unauthenticated.

elements.title: /admin
elements.description:
actions: create, resend, revoke
action:create: Create an invite link; Campaign Masters invite users, owners also admins. The link is shown only now.
  Who: admins and owners.
  In: form { role: admin | user, note? }.
  Out: { op: 'create', link }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden role not invitable.
action:resend: Re-send one of my invites: a fresh link with the same role and note; the old link stops working.
  Who: admins (their own invites) and owners.
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'resend', id, link }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 404 not_found, 409 conflict already used.
action:revoke: Revoke one of my pending invites; its link stops working.
  Who: admins (their own invites) and owners.
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'revoke', id }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 404 not_found, 409 conflict already used.

elements.title: /campaigns
elements.description:
actions: ask, restore, withdraw
action:ask: Ask to join a listed campaign, with an optional note for the CM.
  Who: anyone signed in, not seated in it, while it is listed and mustering; one open request per person.
  In: form { id, note? }.
  Out: { op: 'ask', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not listed, 404 not_found, 409 conflict a request is already open, already holds a seat or not mustering.
action:restore: Restore a deleted campaign within 30 days of its deletion.
  Who: its CM, or an Owner.
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'restore', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found purged, 409 conflict name taken.
action:withdraw: Withdraw my open request to join a campaign.
  Who: the person who asked.
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'withdraw', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found no open request.

elements.title: /campaigns/[id]
elements.description:
actions: ask, assignWarband, clearWarband, leave, transfer, withdraw
action:ask: Ask to join this listed campaign, with an optional note for the CM.
  Who: anyone signed in, not seated in it, while it is listed and mustering; one open request per person.
  In: form { note? }.
  Out: { op: 'ask', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not listed, 404 not_found, 409 conflict a request is already open, already holds a seat or not mustering.
action:assignWarband: Put one of my warbands in my seat here; recheck moves it to this campaign's rules first.
  Who: the seat holder, until the campaign ends.
  In: form { warbandId, recheck? }.
  Out: { op: 'assignWarband', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not mine, 404 not_found no seat, 409 conflict in another campaign, other rules, refused or campaign ended.
action:clearWarband: Take my warband out of my seat here; the seat stays mine.
  Who: the seat holder, until the campaign ends.
  In: form { }.
  Out: { op: 'clearWarband', done: true }.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found no seat, 409 conflict campaign ended.
action:leave: Leave my seat in this campaign; the seat stays, empty.
  Who: the seat holder, while the campaign is mustering.
  In: form { } (the campaign from the path).
  Out: { op: 'leave', done: true }.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found no seat of mine, 409 conflict not mustering.
action:transfer: Hand this campaign's CM role to one of its co-CMs, or take it yourself; the old CM becomes a co-CM.
  Who: Owners, member or not (decision 7).
  In: form { userId } (a co-CM, or the Owner's own id).
  Out: { op: 'transfer', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict not a co-CM or already the CM.
action:withdraw: Withdraw my open request to join this campaign.
  Who: the person who asked.
  In: form { }.
  Out: { op: 'withdraw', done: true }.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found no open request.

elements.title: /campaigns/[id]/manage
elements.description:
actions: addCoCm, addSeats, approve, assign, decline, free, link, links, remove, removeCoCm, removeSeat, rename, revoke, revokeAll, settings, stage, transfer
action:addCoCm: Add a co-CM: an active Admin or Owner.
  Who: the CM.
  In: form { userId }.
  Out: { op: 'addCoCm', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict not an Admin or Owner.
action:addSeats: Add empty seats, named on after the last one.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs, until the campaign ends.
  In: form seatCount { count }.
  Out: { op: 'addSeats', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict 30 seats at most.
action:approve: Approve a request to join into an empty seat.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: form { id (the request), seatId }.
  Out: { op: 'approve', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict seat taken or request already decided.
action:assign: Fill an empty seat with an existing account, picked by name.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs, until the campaign ends.
  In: form { userId, seatId }.
  Out: { op: 'assign', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict seat taken or already holds a seat.
action:decline: Decline a request to join.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: form { id (the request) }.
  Out: { op: 'decline', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict request already decided.
action:free: Free a seat: its player leaves the campaign; the seat stays, empty.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs, until the campaign ends.
  In: form { id, version }.
  Out: { op: 'free', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict changed meanwhile.
action:link: Make a lasting link for an empty seat (until someone takes it or it is withdrawn); it revokes the seat's old link.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs, while the campaign is mustering.
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'link', id, link: { seatId, seatName, url, expiresAt } }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict seat taken or joining closed.
action:links: Make links for every empty seat at once; their old links are revoked. Each is copied later from its seat card.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs, while the campaign is mustering.
  In: form { }.
  Out: { op: 'links', links: { seatId, seatName, url, expiresAt }[] }.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict joining closed.
action:remove: Delete the campaign for everyone; the CM or an Owner can restore it within 30 days.
  Who: the CM.
  In: form { }.
  Out: 303 to /campaigns?view=deleted.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
action:removeCoCm: Remove a co-CM; they keep their seat if they hold one.
  Who: the CM.
  In: form { id (the co-CM's user id) }.
  Out: { op: 'removeCoCm', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
action:removeSeat: Remove an empty seat.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs, until the campaign ends.
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'removeSeat', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict seat taken.
action:rename: Rename a seat.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs, until the campaign ends.
  In: form { id, version, name }.
  Out: { op: 'rename', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict changed meanwhile.
action:revoke: Revoke a seat's open link; it stops working.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'revoke', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
action:revokeAll: Withdraw every open seat link of the campaign at once; they stop working.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: form { }.
  Out: { op: 'revokeAll', withdrawn }.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
action:settings: Save the campaign's settings and house rules, with a version check.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs, until the campaign ends.
  In: form campaignPatch { name, description, gamesPerPlayer?, startsOn?, endsOn?, visibility, houseRules (JSON), rulesSet, allowBeyondLimits, homebrewSets (JSON), version }.
  Out: { op: 'settings', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict changed meanwhile, name taken or campaign ended.
action:stage: Move the campaign to another stage: start it, end it, or take it back to mustering.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: form stageMove { to }.
  Out: { op: 'stage', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict stage move not allowed.
action:transfer: Hand the CM role to a co-CM; the old CM becomes a co-CM.
  Who: the CM, or an Owner.
  In: form { id (the co-CM's user id) }.
  Out: { op: 'transfer', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict not a co-CM.

elements.title: /campaigns/new
elements.description:
actions: create
action:create: Create a campaign from the wizard: the campaign, its CM (the creator) and its seats, in one transaction.
  Who: Owners and Admins.
  In: form campaignCreate { name, kind, description, gamesPerPlayer?, startsOn?, endsOn?, visibility, seats, houseRules (JSON) } (the wizard's six steps).
  Out: 303 to the new campaign's manage page (?created=1, which shows the "Campaign created" message).
  Errors: 400 invalid with field reasons (the wizard returns to that step), 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 409 conflict name taken (on the name field).

elements.title: /homebrew
elements.description:
actions: create, import
action:create: Make a homebrew set and open its editor.
  Who: anyone signed in, on rules they can see.
  In: form homebrewCreate { name, base, start (faction, variant, items or copy), of? }.
  Out: redirect to /homebrew/<id>.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found rules not loaded.
action:import: Import an exported homebrew file as a new set of mine and open it; refused with its problems if it fails its checks.
  Who: anyone signed in, on a base they can see.
  In: form { text } (the file's JSON).
  Out: redirect to /homebrew/<id>.
  Errors: 400 invalid not JSON or with problems, 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found base not loaded.

elements.title: /homebrew/[id]
elements.description:
actions: remove, save, share
action:remove: Delete the set for good and go back to the list.
  Who: its maker; Owners.
  In: form {}.
  Out: redirect to /homebrew.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict in use.
action:save: Save the whole set (its data as one JSON field), with a version check; it is checked and re-indexed.
  Who: its maker.
  In: form homebrewUpdate { version, name?, data (JSON) }.
  Out: { op: 'save', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not its maker, 404 not_found, 409 conflict changed meanwhile.
action:share: Share the set with everyone here, or make it private again.
  Who: its maker.
  In: form { on: true|false }.
  Out: { op: 'share', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not its maker, 404 not_found, 409 conflict base private or in use by others.

elements.title: /owner
elements.description:
actions: anonymise, disable, enable, reset, role
action:anonymise: Anonymise a disabled account: its display name becomes "Former member".
  Who: owners.
  In: form { id, version }.
  Out: { op: 'anonymise', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict not disabled or stale version.
action:disable: Disable an account: it is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in; its history stays.
  Who: owners (never their own account or the last owner).
  In: form { id, version }.
  Out: { op: 'disable', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict last owner, self or stale version.
action:enable: Enable a disabled account again.
  Who: owners.
  In: form { id, version }.
  Out: { op: 'enable', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict stale version.
action:reset: Reset a password to a temporary one, shown once, to be changed at the next sign-in.
  Who: owners.
  In: form { id, version }.
  Out: { op: 'reset', id, done: true, temporary }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict stale version.
action:role: Change a person's role; the last owner can never be demoted.
  Who: owners.
  In: form { id, version, role }.
  Out: { op: 'role', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict last owner or stale version.

elements.title: /owner/backups
elements.description:
actions: restore
action:restore: Restore a backup over the current data; a dump of the current state is written first.
  Who: owners.
  In: form { name } a backup file name from the list.
  Out: { op: 'restore', name, safety } the name of the dump written before restoring.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found no such backup, 500 internal pg_restore failed.

elements.title: /owner/backups/[name]
elements.description:
GET
GET: Download one backup file (audited).
  Who: owners.
  In: path name, a backup file name from the list.
  Out: 200 the dump as application/octet-stream, as an attachment.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found no such backup.

elements.title: /owner/invites
elements.description:
actions: create, resend, revoke
action:create: Create an invite link for an admin or a user; the link is shown only now.
  Who: owners.
  In: form { role: admin | user, note? }.
  Out: { op: 'create', link }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden.
action:resend: Re-send an invite: a fresh link with the same role and note; the old link stops working.
  Who: owners (any invite).
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'resend', id, link }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 404 not_found, 409 conflict already used.
action:revoke: Revoke a pending invite; its link stops working.
  Who: owners (any invite).
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'revoke', id }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 404 not_found, 409 conflict already used.

elements.title: /owner/rules
elements.description:
actions: reload
action:reload: Read the rules folders again and replace the cache; a folder that fails its check is not loaded.
  Who: owners.
  In: form {} (nothing).
  Out: { op: 'reload', ok, failed } the number of folders loaded and not loaded.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not an owner.

elements.title: /owner/settings
elements.description:
actions: save
action:save: Change the copy-wide text size, accent and port.
  Who: owner only.
  In: form settingsPatch { textScale?, accent?, port? } (at least one; the port is left out while it is locked).
  Out: { op: 'save', done: true, moveTo } — moveTo is the new address after a port change, else null.
  Errors: 400 invalid (field messages), 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 409 conflict (port locked or in use, with a message on the port field).

elements.description: layout

elements.title: /warbands
elements.description:
actions: import
action:import: Import a Trench Companion text export as a new warband; names that do not match are reported.
  Who: anyone signed in.
  In: form warbandImport { text, rules (core or core+expansion) }.
  Out: { op: 'import', done: true, id, name, unmatched, ambiguous }.
  Errors: 400 invalid not a warband, 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found rules not loaded, 409 conflict no rules.

elements.title: /warbands/[id]
elements.description:
actions: assign, buy, clearImage, editFighter, fireteams, image, locations, patch, recruit, remove, removeFighter, removeUpgrade, sell, stashBuy, stashGive, stashSell, unassign, upgrade
action:assign: Put this warband in my seat of a campaign; recheck moves it to the campaign's rules first.
  Who: the warband's owner, seated in that campaign.
  In: form seatForm { campaignId, recheck? }.
  Out: { op: 'assign', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found no seat, 409 conflict in another campaign, other rules or refused.
action:buy: Buy kit for a fighter from the Equip dialog.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { fid, lineId }.
  Out: { op: 'buy', done: true, id: lineId }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict refused with its reasons.
action:clearImage: Remove a fighter's picture.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { fid }.
  Out: { op: 'clearImage', done: true, id: fid }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
action:editFighter: Edit a fighter: name, group (Dead included), Experience, skills and injuries (one per line).
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { fid, version, name, group, xp, skills, injuries }.
  Out: { op: 'editFighter', done: true, id }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict changed meanwhile or refused.
action:fireteams: Save the fireteams (pairs of fighters).
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { fireteams (JSON) }.
  Out: { op: 'fireteams', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict refused with its reasons.
action:image: Upload a fighter's picture (multipart field `image`): PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB, stored as sent.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: multipart form { fid, image }.
  Out: { op: 'image', done: true, id: fid }.
  Errors: 400 invalid wrong type or too large, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
action:locations: Save the locations (a name and a note each).
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { locations (JSON) }.
  Out: { op: 'locations', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
action:patch: Save the warband's details: name, Patron, ducat limit, banks and notes, with a version check.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form warbandPatch { version, name, patronId, ducatLimit, stashDucats, unspentGlory, notes }.
  Out: { op: 'patch', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict changed meanwhile or refused.
action:recruit: Recruit an entry from the Add fighter dialog, with the upgrades and loadout picked, paid from the banks.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { unitId, name?, up:<upgrade id> boxes, loadout (its lines, comma-separated) }.
  Out: { op: 'recruit', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict refused with its reasons.
action:remove: Delete the warband for good and go back to the list.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { }.
  Out: redirect to /warbands.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
action:removeFighter: Remove a fighter; its worth goes back to the banks.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { fid }.
  Out: { op: 'removeFighter', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict refused with its reasons.
action:removeUpgrade: Take an upgrade off a fighter.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { fid, upgradeId }.
  Out: { op: 'removeUpgrade', done: true, id: upgradeId }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict refused with its reasons.
action:sell: Sell one piece of a fighter's bought kit.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { fid, lineId }.
  Out: { op: 'sell', done: true, id: fid }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict refused with its reasons.
action:stashBuy: Buy kit into the stash.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { lineId }.
  Out: { op: 'stashBuy', done: true, id: lineId }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict refused with its reasons.
action:stashGive: Give a piece from the stash to a fighter.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { lineId, fighterId }.
  Out: { op: 'stashGive', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict refused with its reasons.
action:stashSell: Sell one piece from the stash.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { lineId }.
  Out: { op: 'stashSell', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
action:unassign: Take this warband out of its campaign seat.
  Who: the warband's owner (the seat holder).
  In: form { campaignId }.
  Out: { op: 'unassign', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found no seat, 409 conflict campaign ended.
action:upgrade: Give a fighter an upgrade from the Equip dialog.
  Who: the warband's owner.
  In: form { fid, upgradeId }.
  Out: { op: 'upgrade', done: true, id: upgradeId }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict refused with its reasons.

elements.title: /warbands/new
elements.description:
actions: create
action:create: Create a warband from the wizard and open its builder; from a seat it takes the campaign's rules and the seat.
  Who: anyone signed in; with campaignId, a player seated in that campaign.
  In: form warbandCreate { rules, factionId, variantId?, patronId?, name, ducatLimit?, campaignId? }.
  Out: redirect to /warbands/<id>.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found rules or seat, 409 conflict no rules or campaign ended.

elements.title: /uploads/fighters/[id]
elements.description:
GET
GET: A fighter's image, with its stored content type. The address carries the fighter's version (?v=), so a browser may keep it; it is private, never shared caches.
  Who: the warband's owner; the CM and co-CMs of the campaign it sits in.
  In: path id (the fighter).
  Out: 200 image/png, image/jpeg or image/webp.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found no image or not visible.

elements.title: Welcome, setup, sign-in, invite and help pages
elements.description: The welcome page and four-step setup wizard on a fresh install (Owner, Look, Server, Done); the one sign-in screen for every role, in the same split as the welcome page; joining by invite; help and legal placeholder pages.

elements.title: /help
elements.description: layout

elements.title: /invite/[token]
elements.description:
actions: default
action:default: Accept an invite: create the account with the invite's role and sign it in.
  Who: anyone holding the invite link.
  In: form { username, displayName, password }.
  Out: 303 to the new account's area with a browser-session cookie.
  Errors: 400 invalid (taken username, common password), 404 not_found unknown or withdrawn invite, 409 conflict used or expired.

elements.title: /join/[token]
elements.description:
actions: signin, signup, take
action:signin: Sign in, then take the seat with that account.
  Who: anyone holding the seat link with an account here.
  In: form { username, password }.
  Out: 303 to the campaign's page, with a browser-session cookie.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated wrong username or password, 404 not_found unknown or expired link, 409 conflict link used or revoked, already holds a seat, 429 rate_limited.
action:signup: Create an account and take the seat with it, in one step.
  Who: anyone holding the seat link, signed out.
  In: form { username, displayName, password }.
  Out: 303 to the campaign's page, with a browser-session cookie for the new account.
  Errors: 400 invalid (taken username, common password), 404 not_found unknown or expired link, 409 conflict link used or revoked, 429 rate_limited.
action:take: Take the seat with the account already signed in.
  Who: anyone signed in who holds the seat link.
  In: form { } (the token from the path).
  Out: 303 to the campaign's page.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found unknown or expired link, 409 conflict link used or revoked, already holds a seat.

elements.title: /login
elements.description:
actions: default
action:default: Sign in with username and password; one form for every role.
  Who: anyone not signed in.

elements.title: /logout

actions: default · layout

elements.title: JSON API v1

elements.title: /api/v1/audit

elements.title: /api/v1/auth/login

elements.title: /api/v1/auth/logout

POST

elements.title: /api/v1/auth/logout-everywhere

  In: nothing.
  Out: 204.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns
elements.description:
GET POST
GET: A page of campaign cards, newest first.
  Who: anyone signed in (mine = rights or a seat; listed = listed ones the caller is not in; deleted = the last 30 days, own as CM, all for Owners).
  In: query ?scope=mine|listed|deleted&after=<id>&limit=<1..100, default 50>
  Out: 200 { items: CampaignCard[], next }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated.

  In: { name, kind, description?, gamesPerPlayer?, startsOn?, endsOn?, visibility, seats: 2..30, houseRules? }

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]
elements.description:
DELETE GET PATCH
DELETE: Delete a campaign (soft): hidden at once, restorable for 30 days.
  Who: the CM.
  In: path id.
  Out: 204
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not the CM or other site, 404 not_found.
GET: One campaign, with an ETag of its version.
  Who: its CM, co-CMs and players; anyone signed in if it is listed; while deleted, its CM and Owners.

  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found unknown or not visible.
PATCH: Change the settings and house rules; the type cannot change.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id; { name, description?, gamesPerPlayer?, startsOn?, endsOn?, visibility, houseRules?, version }
  Out: 200 Campaign
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not CM or co-CM or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict changed meanwhile, name taken or campaign ended.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/candidates
elements.description:
GET
GET: People to pick from, up to 10 matching q: for=seat (default) active accounts without a seat here; for=co_cm active Admins and Owners without rights here.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs (for=seat); the CM (for=co_cm).
  In: path id; query ?q=<1..32>&for=seat|co_cm
  Out: 200 { items: Candidate[] }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/co-cms
/api/v1/campaigns/[id]/co-cms/[userId]
elements.description:
DELETE
DELETE: Take co-CM rights away.
  Who: the CM.
  In: path id, userId.
  Out: 200 { members: CampaignMember[] }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not the CM or other site, 404 not_found not a co-CM.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/requests
elements.description:
GET POST
GET: The open requests to join, oldest first.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id.
  Out: 200 { items: JoinRequest[] }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
POST: Ask to join: one open request at a time.
  Who: anyone signed in without a seat; listed campaigns while mustering only.
  In: path id; { note? }
  Out: 201 JoinRequest
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not listed or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict a request is already open, already holds a seat or not mustering.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/requests/[rid]/approve
elements.description:
POST
POST: Approve a request into an empty seat.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs; mustering only.
  In: path id, rid; { seatId }
  Out: 200 Seat
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict seat taken, request already decided or not mustering.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/requests/[rid]/decline
elements.description:
POST
POST: Decline a request.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id, rid.
  Out: 204
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict request already decided.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/requests/mine
elements.description:
DELETE
DELETE: Withdraw one's own open request to join.
  Who: the person who asked.
  In: path id.
  Out: 204
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site, 404 not_found no open request.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/restore
elements.description:
POST
POST: Restore a deleted campaign within 30 days.
  Who: its CM and Owners.
  In: path id.
  Out: 200 Campaign
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden or other site, 404 not_found unknown or purged, 409 conflict name taken or not deleted.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/seat-links
elements.description:
DELETE POST
DELETE: Withdraw every open seat link of the campaign at once; they stop working.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id.
  Out: 200 { withdrawn: number }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.
POST: Make a fresh lasting link for every empty seat; their old links stop working.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id.
  Out: 201 { links: SeatLink[] }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict joining closed.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/seats
elements.description:
GET POST
GET: The seats in number order; people outside the campaign see no players.
  Who: anyone who may see the campaign.
  In: path id.
  Out: 200 { items: Seat[] }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found.
POST: Add seats; a campaign has 30 at most.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id; { count }
  Out: 201 { items: Seat[] } (the new seats)
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict 30 seats at most or campaign ended.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/seats/[seatId]
elements.description:
DELETE PATCH
DELETE: Remove an empty seat; a campaign keeps at least 2.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id, seatId.
  Out: 204
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict seat taken, too few seats or campaign ended.
PATCH: Rename a seat and/or free it (the player leaves the seat).
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id, seatId; { version, name?, free? }
  Out: 200 Seat
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict changed meanwhile or campaign ended.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/seats/[seatId]/assign
elements.description:
POST
POST: Add a person by name to an empty seat; until the campaign ends.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id, seatId; { userId }
  Out: 200 Seat
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict seat taken, already holds a seat or campaign ended.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/seats/[seatId]/invite
elements.description:
DELETE GET POST
DELETE: Withdraw the seat's open link.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id, seatId.
  Out: 204
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden or other site, 404 not_found.
GET: The seat's open link again, to copy; recorded in the audit log.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id, seatId.
  Out: 200 SeatLinkCopy
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found no seat or no open link, 409 conflict link made before links could be copied.
POST: Make a lasting link for an empty seat (valid until the seat is taken or the link withdrawn); the seat's old link stops working.
  Who: the CM and co-CMs.
  In: path id, seatId.
  Out: 201 SeatLink
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict seat taken or joining closed.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/seats/mine
elements.description:
DELETE
DELETE: Leave one's own seat.
  Who: a player in the campaign; mustering only.
  In: path id.
  Out: 204
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site, 404 not_found no seat, 409 conflict not mustering.

elements.title: /api/v1/campaigns/[id]/seats/mine/warband
elements.description:
DELETE PUT

  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site, 404 not_found no seat, 409 conflict campaign ended.

  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not my warband or other site, 404 not_found no seat or warband, 409 conflict in another campaign, other rules, refused with its reasons or campaign ended.

elements.title: /api/v1/homebrew

  In: { name, base, start: faction|variant|items|copy, of? (the faction or variant) }

  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site, 404 not_found base not loaded.

elements.title: /api/v1/homebrew/[id]
elements.description:

  In: path id; { version, name?, data }

  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not its maker or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict changed meanwhile.

elements.title: /api/v1/homebrew/[id]/export

  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 404 not_found.

elements.title: /api/v1/homebrew/[id]/share
elements.description:

  In: path id.

  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not its maker or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict in use by others.

  Who: its maker.
  In: path id.
  Out: 200 Homebrew
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not its maker or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict its base is private.

  Errors: 400 invalid with the problems, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site, 404 not_found base not loaded.

  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site.

elements.title: /api/v1/rules/node

elements.title: /api/v1/rules/nodes

elements.title: /api/v1/rules/sets

GET

  In: nothing.

  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not an owner or other site.

elements.title: /api/v1/seat-invites/[token]
elements.description:

  Errors: 400 invalid, 404 not_found unknown link.

elements.title: /api/v1/seat-invites/[token]/accept
elements.description:

elements.title: /api/v1/settings
elements.description:

elements.title: /api/v1/users

elements.title: /api/v1/users/[id]
elements.description:

elements.title: /api/v1/users/[id]/anonymise

POST

  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not an owner or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict stale version or not disabled.

views.title: Create a campaign
views.description:
**An Owner or Admin creates a campaign in a six-step wizard and becomes its Campaign Master.**

**Decisions**
- Two types, Carcass Front and generic; the type is fixed after creation.
- Seats are made at creation (2 to 30) as "Seat 1" … "Seat N"; more can be added later.
- Campaign, CM row and seats are made in one transaction; a name taken by a campaign that is not deleted
  (ignoring case) is a conflict and the wizard returns to Basics.
- House rules are the CM's own words, stored as typed JSON switches; no book text ships with the app.
- The wizard's Map step is a placeholder until step 2.5.

steps.label: wizard: basics, schedule, seats, house rules, review

views.title: Compendium
views.description:
**Anyone signed in reads the rules by version: sections like the Trench Companion compendium, a page per element with every link in and out, keyword pop-ups and a neighbourhood graph.**

**Decisions**
- Sections: Core Rules, Warbands, Comprehensive Rules, Battlekit (by category, search and filters), Campaigns,
  Scenarios, Errata & FAQ (what changed between two versions, from comparing the folders).
- The graph shows an element's neighbours to depth 2 (d3-force); clicking a node opens its page.
- Homebrew sets appear like any other set, marked Homebrew, to those who can see them.

steps.label: render text links, lay out the graph

views.title: First start: migrations, backup, the setup wizard
views.description:
**A group installs the app and sets it up in the browser, Jellyfin style, without editing files.**

**Decisions**
- Before any pending migration runs, the app writes a pg_dump to the backups volume (forward-only migrations;
  the dump is the undo). Migrations run in one transaction under an advisory lock; a failure stops the app.
- Setup is open while no owner exists: every page goes to /welcome and the log says "Setup is open at
  <address>". There is no token. On a shared network the first visitor becomes the owner (accepted risk).
- The wizard (Owner, Look, Server, Done) checks each step in the browser and posts once. One transaction
  locks the settings row, re-checks that no owner exists, creates the owner, saves text size, accent and port,
  marks setup done and signs the owner in. A second submit is refused.
- After setup, /welcome and /setup send people to /login; setup never shows again unless the copy is
  reinstalled.
- /health/ready answers 503 until migrations are applied; /health/live answers as soon as the process runs.

steps.label: no owner: log that setup is open
opens any page, lands on /welcome, presses Setup, fills the four steps
lock settings, insert owner, save settings

views.title: Homebrew factions
views.description:
**A player creates their own faction, variant or items with custom rules, in the rules folder format, and builds warbands with it.**

**Decisions**
- Start blank or from a copy of an official faction or variant. Tabs: faction rules, units, armoury, keywords,
  sharing. The same checker as the rules folders runs live.
- Private until the creator shares it with the install; a CM chooses which homebrew a campaign allows.
- Stored in homebrew_sets (data in the rules format) and indexed into the rules cache as set hb:<id>, so the
  compendium, graph and builder treat it like any other set. Exports and imports as a rules folder.
- Saves send the whole set with its version; a draft with problems saves with its report, and the cache keeps
  the last version that passed (last_good), so warbands built on it keep loading.
- Ids live in the set's namespace (type:hb-<tag>/…); a copy clones what the faction or variant owns.
- Decisions 61 to 63.

steps.label: new homebrew, edit units and armoury, share
check it builds on the campaign's rules
new warband on homebrew, assign to seat

views.title: House rules from the library
views.description:
**The CM drags preset rules (or writes their own) into the campaign's house rules and sets their values; players see them on the campaign page.**

**Decisions**
- Two kinds: passive ("In play", players apply them at the table) and configuration ("Setting", a game value
  the app uses from step 3 on). Values are stored now; nothing applies them yet.
- The preset catalogue is pure code in our own words (no book text), each preset with typed value fields,
  defaults, limits and conflicts. A preset is added at most once; up to 30 rules.
- House rules stay typed JSONB on the campaign; old rules became passive with no preset.
- Drag and drop is native HTML; an Add button does the same for click and keyboard. Dragging a rule's grip
  back to the library removes it, as the × button does.

steps.label: drag a preset or press Add, set values, save
campaign page lists the rules with their values

views.title: Invite and join
views.description:
**Nobody registers alone: an owner or admin sends a link that fixes the role.**

**Decisions**
- Owners invite admins and users; admins invite users; users cannot invite.
- An invite is valid for 7 days and works once; only its token hash is stored. The inviter sees pending
  invites and can revoke or re-send (a new link) them.
- Accepting creates the account and signs it in, in one transaction with a row lock, so two people accepting
  the same link at once make exactly one account.

steps.label: lock invite, insert user, mark used

views.title: Ask to join, then approve
views.description:
**Anyone signed in can ask to join a listed campaign while it is mustering; the CM or a co-CM places them.**

**Decisions**
- Only listed campaigns, only while mustering; one open request per person and campaign.
- Approving needs an empty seat (preselected to the lowest); the seat is locked so two approvals cannot fill it twice.
- Declined and withdrawn requests stay as history; the person may ask again.

steps.label: lock seat, fill it, mark approved

views.title: Managing people
views.description:
**The owner keeps the group's accounts in order without email.**

**Decisions**
- Owners see every account; admins see the users they invited.
- Changing a role or disabling an account never removes the last owner.
- Disabling ends every session at once; history stays.
- A password reset sets a readable temporary password that must be changed at the next sign-in.
- A disabled account can be anonymised: its display name becomes "Former member".
- Every change is written to the audit log in the same transaction.

views.title: Failure and recovery
views.description:
**A group without an ops person can see what is wrong and get back on its feet.**

**Decisions**
- A bad .env stops the app at start and names the setting (never its secret value).
- If the database is down, /health/ready answers 503, pages say so clearly, and the pool reconnects with
  backoff on its own.
- Every response carries X-Request-Id; errors use one shape with the request id.
- The owner downloads a backup or restores one from the owner area; the app warns when served over plain HTTP.
- A locked-out owner is recovered with a documented docker compose exec command.

views.title: Load the rules folders
views.description:
**At start, and when the Owner presses Reload, the app reads every rules version folder, checks it and caches its elements and links.**

**Decisions**
- One complete folder per version (core-1.0.1, core-1.0.2); an expansion (carcass-front-1.0) names its base.
  A new version starts as a copy of the last folder, then is edited. The folder is git-ignored and mounted
  read-only (RULES_DIR, default /data/rules): no book text ships with the app.
- The checker refuses unknown keys and any id that does not resolve; a folder that fails is not loaded, and the
  Owner sees the file and id at fault. Loaded folders are cached as rules.sets, nodes and edges.
- Campaigns choose a core version (plus Carcass Front for that type); warbands keep theirs.

steps.label: replace the cached sets, nodes and edges

views.title: Join by seat link
views.description:
**The CM makes a lasting link for a seat and copies it from the seat's card; the person who opens it takes that seat, with a new account if needed.**

**Decisions**
- One link per seat, valid until someone takes the seat or the CM withdraws it (no expiry; links made before
  1 Nov 2026 keep their 7 days). The token hash finds the link; the link itself is stored encrypted
  (AES-256-GCM, key LINK_KEY or derived from the database password) so Copy link always gives the same one.
  Making a new link revokes the seat's open one. Links made before encryption cannot be copied ("old link").
- The first time the link page opens, opened_at is set and shown on the seat card.
- Links work only while the campaign is mustering. While active, the CM adds people by name only.
- Joining runs in one transaction with the link row locked: two people with the same link cannot both get the
  seat. A seat still on its default name takes the player's display name.
- A person holds at most one seat per campaign. Sign-up on the join page is rate limited.

revoke open link, insert hash and encrypted link

lock link, fill seat, mark used

views.title: Sessions and the account page
views.description:
**Everyone controls their own sign-in.**

**Decisions**
- Every request resolves the cookie to a session and user; disabled accounts and expired sessions are
  rejected. A session in use slides forward about once a day.
- Everyone can change their display name and password and sign out of every device.
- An hourly job (one runner at a time, by advisory lock) removes expired sessions, invites and setup tokens,
  and prunes audit entries older than the retention period (180 days).

views.title: Instance settings: text size, accent and port
views.description:
**The Owner changes how the copy looks and where it listens, from the browser.**

**Decisions**
- One row in app.settings holds text size (90 to 130 percent), accent (five contrast-tested presets) and port.
  Every page reads them through the root layout: data-accent on <html>, font-size on :root.
- A port change outside Docker: the custom server opens the new port first, the browser is sent to the new
  address, and the old port closes once the browser arrives or after a short wait. If the new port is taken,
  nothing changes and the Owner sees why.
- In Docker (PORT_LOCKED=1) and in development the port is read-only: Compose owns the published port, so the
  page shows the .env line to change instead.

steps.label: opens /owner/settings, changes text size, accent or port
open the new port, close the old one

views.title: Sign-in: one screen for every role
views.description:
**Owners, admins and users sign in on the same screen and land in their own area.**

**Decisions**
- Five tries a minute per username and per address (in memory); then "Too many tries".
- A wrong password and an unknown username get the same message; the hash check runs for unknown names too.
- The session token is 32 random bytes in an httpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie (Secure over HTTPS); only its
  SHA-256 is stored. "Remember me": 30 days, extended by use; otherwise a browser session.
- Owner lands on /owner, Admin on /admin, User on /home; a required password change goes to
  /account/password first. Every sign-in is written to the audit log.

steps.label: cookie, redirect to the role area

views.title: Build a warband
views.description:
**A player builds a warband like the Trench Companion builder: faction, variant, patron and limit, then fighters and their kit, checked on every change; then assigns it to their campaign seat.**

**Decisions**
- The player owns the warband; it sits in at most one campaign at a time (seats.warband_id is unique).
- Every change runs the warband engine; a refused change says why. A campaign whose CM allows going beyond
  limits turns refusals into warnings for warbands in it.
- Groups: Elites, Troops, Mercenaries, Special, Dead; stash, fireteams, locations. Each fighter has an image slot
  (empty by default; PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB, checked by file signature, stored in the uploads volume).
- Add fighter offers the entry's upgrades and loadouts; the engine checks them with the recruit, as one purchase.
- A campaign keeps one rules version: the CM cannot change it while a seated warband uses other rules.
- Export as Trench Companion text and JSON; import Trench Companion text.
- The stash, fireteams and locations are typed JSONB on the warband (the engine's own shapes); fighters are
  rows, in roster order (prices depend on it). Buying takes the worth it adds from the banks; selling gives it
  back.
